claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Nantucket off Nantucket (20th 6 p. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Hermann (Brem.), Wenke, Bremen July 8[?], via South-
ampton 10th, with mdse. and 685[?] pass. to Oelrichs[?] & Co. Had west-
erly winds during the passage. July 11, 7 a. m., off Cowes, passed
steamship New-York, hence for Bremen; 13th, passed ship Zephyr,
bound E; 19th, lat. 42 15, long. 62, passed ship Tonawanda, bound W;
20th, 6 p. m., off Nantucket, passed steamship Hibernia[?], for New-
York, and steamship City of Cork, bound E. The steamship Alle-
mania left[?] Southampton July 10, 3 p. m.
